has_open_metal_sites.definition: true when Zeo++ -oms reports open_metal_site_count greater than zero

open_metal_site_count.definition: number reported by Zeo++ in the #OMS output field for the supplied canonical CIF

surface_definition_A.definition: surface-definition distance printed by this Zeo++ build during OMS detection

interpretation.caution: This is a Zeo++ geometry/connectivity heuristic on the supplied structure, not experimental proof of an accessible or catalytically active open metal site.
interpretation.input_expectation: The documented use case is a desolvated MOF framework. Coordinated guests, disorder, missing atoms, bonding interpretation, and structure preparation can change the count.

provenance_requirements: canonical CIF path, byte size, and SHA-256
manifest path, row index, and SHA-256
exact argv, return code, elapsed time, and output SHA-256
raw OMS output line and Zeo++ stdout/stderr tails
